stations.name: Recover control
stations.get: Order in the project: branches, records and checks.

stations.get: One finished room, one complete Tom who walks, sits and turns, speech under 2 seconds, frame headroom.

stations.get: The whole street, day and night, built from proved pieces, with people in plain clothes.

stations.name: Thirty minutes that hold
stations.get: The town remembers what you did: arrivals, deliveries, consequences, the office and the ledger, talk.

stations.name: Friends' evening
stations.get: Your friends play thirty minutes on your PC, with a $5 cap per evening.
stations.note: Around January if phase 1 passes soon. Low confidence.

stations.name: The Hook
stations.get: The district: one more block, then the 14 main characters, about 30 regulars and a crowd.

stations.name: Crime and combat
stations.get: The escalation ladder, fists and improvised weapons. Guns rare, and last.

stations.name: Empire
stations.get: Your first business, first recruit and first racket, and a rival who reacts.

stations.name: The story
stations.get: Jobs, the main arc and its endings: 30 to 40 hours.

stations.name: Release
stations.get: Menus, music, polish and testing: the finished game.

bosses.name: The Glide
bosses.what: How far a planted foot slides while Tom walks, stops and turns.
bosses.last: 25 Oct: Epic's walk with its contact marks rewritten and a stricter lock: eight of ten moments under 3 cm by eye. The stop's re-step still slides 10 to 11 cm and the run's start about 4.5 cm. Set aside after two tries; a third is your call.

bosses.name: The Long Pause
bosses.what: Seconds from the end of your question to the character's first sound.
bosses.last: 25 Oct: re-timed the game's way with the cast voice on the card: 4.14 s median. The model drafts in 0.75 s and its check adds 1.1 s; the cast voice takes 2.8 s. Your call on the voice.

bosses.name: The Stutter
bosses.what: The worst single frame on a walk down the street.
bosses.last: 23 Oct: the 87 ms stall is gone. One frame per walk still reaches 42 to 55 ms when the voice speaks; without the voice the worst is 24 ms.

bosses.name: The Tailor
bosses.what: Period clothes on the cast, starting with Tom's outfit.
bosses.last: 25 Oct: Study 6 set the target (jacket about 20,000 triangles, trousers about 9,000, 2048 textures, skinned). Next: Marvelous Designer, one paid month, on your sign-up.

bosses.name: The Empty Chair
bosses.what: Someone sits down in the game as you play it.
bosses.last: 25 Oct: Epic's sample in the project already holds a bench interaction built on smart objects; it is next, on the same mover.

bosses.name: The Clean Room
bosses.what: Mickey's office worn, lived in and free of glitches, at the Hook sheet's bar.
bosses.last: The method works on shop fronts: eight fronts got their wear this week and passed.

bosses.name: The Memory Hog
bosses.display: Game alone 5.9 GB, under the 6 GB line
bosses.last: Down from 9.9 GB with the voice. Your ruling of 24 Oct: the 6 GB line counts the game alone; game and voice peak at 8.7 GB on your 10 GB card.

bosses.name: The Shadow Tax
bosses.what: Spare graphics card time, kept for what the street still needs.
bosses.last: Night beats its 1.4 ms target. Day is under its 2.5 ms target, accepted by your ruling of 24 Oct until phase 2's street budget.
